patch_description: This version uses a topology-diverse multistart strategy rather than refining only two nearly symmetric lattice states.  It generates several staggered layered seeds, jointly improves each geometry with smooth squared-distance constraints, then solves an exact linear program for the radii at the resulting centers.  The LP removes radius-allocation bias from nonlinear optimization and lets asymmetric boundary circles receive larger radii when beneficial.  The best valid LP-scored layout is returned with a strict safety margin.
